purpose: Field-by-field audit between Rocq proof records and current Kairos projection structures.

decision.summary: Kairos now has dedicated kernel-clause, product-summary and step-contract projection modules before diagnostics and backend planning. The audit keeps tracking remaining gaps: lowered low-level proof objects are not yet a standalone Rocq exchange schema.
principles: Rocq concepts define the comparison target; proof_export must not define the theorem shape by accident.
The product-summary projection must expose ProofStepSummary and SummaryClauseFamilies explicitly.
The kernel-clause projection must expose KernelClause explicitly before proof_export JSON, relational lowering, or Why3.
The step-contract projection must expose StepContract explicitly before Why3 helper grouping, labels, scheduling, or term-level sharing.
The projections record which Rocq stage cut they correspond to, but their Kairos names are semantic.
Diagnostics may serialize the projection, but may not be the only place where the projection exists.

current_fragments.name: Ir.product_step_summary
current_fragments.role: Canonical summary carrier used by verification passes.
current_fragments.limitation: It contains identity, requires, ensures, safe cases and unsafe cases, but not explicit product-step anchors or generated clause families.

current_fragments.name: Product_summary_projection.summary
current_fragments.role: Neutral domain projection for product-summary identity, requirements, runtime requirements, ensures, and safe/unsafe cases.
current_fragments.limitation: It gives the alignment boundary for product summaries. Kernel clauses are exposed separately by Kernel_clause_projection.

current_fragments.name: Kernel_clause_projection.kernel_clause
current_fragments.role: Neutral domain projection for TimeTag, TimedFact, product anchors, KernelClause, and classified clauses before proof_export.
current_fragments.limitation: The classified wrapper carries implementation context for backend lowering; the underlying kernel_clause is the Rocq-facing object.

current_fragments.name: Step_contract_projection.step_contract
current_fragments.role: Neutral domain projection for step contracts before Why3 grouping, helper naming, term sharing, or scheduling.
current_fragments.limitation: It exposes summary identity and covered cases, but the eventual lowered LowExpr proof object is still represented by backend/runtime formulas.

current_fragments.name: Proof_kernel_types.proof_step_summary_ir
current_fragments.role: Diagnostic/exchange grouping of product steps and relational clauses.
current_fragments.limitation: It contains steps and clauses, but drops explicit summary identity, propagation_requires, requires, runtime_requires, ensures, safe cases and unsafe cases as first-class fields.

current_fragments.name: Why_runtime_view.runtime_product_transition_view
current_fragments.limitation: It approximates step contracts but is backend-shaped, not a neutral StepContract projection: it lacks summary identity, explicit covered step list for grouped contracts, and lowered LowExpr data as a proof object.

current_fragments.name: Why_contracts.step_contract_info
current_fragments.role: Why3 terms and labels used for backend emission.
current_fragments.limitation: It is already after backend term compilation, so it is too late to be the neutral step-contract projection.

record_audit.conclusion: The raw fact vocabulary matches. Relational fact descriptors are a lowered projection and should stay separate.
The product-state anchor is available directly.

fields.kairos_field: Kernel_clause_projection.product_step construction context: program_guard, assume_guard, guarantee_guard, step_class

record_audit.conclusion: The Rocq anchor is now explicit; the concrete product_step wrapper only carries construction/lowering context.

fields.rocq_field: No KernelClause field; classified by SummaryClauseFamilies

record_audit.conclusion: Kernel_clause_projection exposes the Rocq KernelClause payload plus a semantic family used to instantiate SummaryClauseFamilies. Relational clauses are a later projection.
The identity exists in canonical IR, but proof_step_summary_ir does not store it explicitly.

Product_summary_projection now exposes the summary fields used by step-contract extraction. Generated clause payloads are exposed separately by Kernel_clause_projection, and their families are defined by Obligation_family_projection.
Obligation_family_projection now exposes the OCaml predicates corresponding to Rocq SummaryClauseFamilies.
Step_contract_projection is now the neutral pre-Why3 step-contract view. The remaining partial field is the exact Rocq notion of covered product steps versus current covered summary cases.

target_projection.name: product_summary_projection
must_not_include: relational lowering unless explicitly marked as derived
